entries.en: to get stuck in the throat (of a fishbone, etc.); to choke

entries.zh: 哽住，咽不下去；卡住通不过
entries.en: stuck in the throat, unable to swallow; obstructed so as not to pass
entries.notes: L 栏「noep uedpa」当为「no puede pasar」之残写，H「鯁袂吞」与之相容，惟「袂/未」存疑。

entries.en: to lay crosswise; to lie across (a road)
entries.notes: L 尾注「ttlica」不可解，唯「atrauesar…el camino」与 H「橫」义已明。

entries.en: to lie across the road; to block the way
to lay something across; to put a thing crosswise

entries.zh: 包买全部货物；把货物囤买一空
entries.en: to buy up all the goods; to corner the merchandise wholesale
entries.notes: 17 世纪「atravesar」有包买囤积货物之义，与 H「包貨」密合。

entries.en: to lay a beam across; to set a roof beam in place
entries.notes: L「la Bija」当为「la viga」（梁木），与 H「棟」及 M/R 之 tong 相合。

entries.en: to lay a ridge beam across; timber for ridgepole and beams

entries.zh: 乖戾顶撞；出言相驳（谓人心性横蛮、好顶嘴）
entries.en: cross-grained and contradictious; to answer back; (of a person) perverse
entries.notes: L「tequesto: apl dice el apaparado」残缺难读，取 17 世纪「atravesado＝心性乖张」义，与 H「駁」相应。

entries.zh: 横放重货；把重货横置（搬运、装载）
entries.en: to lay heavy goods athwart; to stow heavy cargo crosswise
entries.notes: L 仅作「atrauesa la hacienda」，H/R 皆作「重貨」，故取横置重货义。

entries.zh: 横架竹椽；以竹横铺覆盖（屋架横木）
entries.en: to lay bamboo across (as battens or roofing); crosswise bamboo frame
entries.notes: L「atrauesan, o marco」与 H「覆竹[疑:腹竹]」均不完整，义由「横架竹木」推定，存疑。

entries.en: to dare; to venture

entries.zh: 侵凌冒犯；对人放肆不逊
entries.en: to presume upon someone; to encroach insolently
entries.notes: L「atreuerse aucarn」残缺，依 H「侵」取侵犯冒犯义。

entries.en: rash; presumptuous
entries.notes: H「漭」当通「莽」，与 M bong 相合；L 尾「tamì」不可解，义存疑。

entries.en: to dare to act and dare to answer for it; to take the risk upon oneself

entries.zh: 斗胆；大胆放肆（多指冒昧行事）
entries.en: audacious; to have the gall (to presume)
entries.notes: L 附拉丁语「in malis partibus」（于恶事上大胆），与「斗胆」相合。

entries.en: bold; daring
brutish and wild; wildly unrestrained
entries.notes: H 作「莽蕩」[疑:冏湯]，与 L「bestial」取粗野狂放义。

entries.en: careless and rash; rough
entries.notes: L「feroz」（凶猛）与 H「粗心」有义差，取其粗鲁莽撞相通处。

entries.en: firm and unforgiving; unyielding
entries.notes: L「atreuido firme con - ni fabent」残缺，仅 H/R「不諒」可据，义存疑。

entries.en: brave; valiant

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕疑为翻阅、检点书册
entries.en: [damaged original; gloss uncertain] perh. to leaf through a book
entries.notes: L「A til delibin」无法辨读，H/R 只余「冊」与「扯過/冊過」，姑备一说。
